court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: Family Court at Pune in P.A. No.635/2004 and P.E. No.134/2003
case_name: Aswini Ashok Bhosale vs Shri Ashok Narsingrao Bhosale & Others

parties.respondent_defendant: Mr. Ashok Narsinghrao Bhosale (husband) and others

facts_of_case: The respondent filed a petition for divorce under Sections 13(1)(i), (ia) and (ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. The appellant challenged the trial court's decision to grant a decree of dissolution of marriage on the ground of adultery and cruelty.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the respondent to prove that after solemnization of marriage, the appellant had voluntary sexual intercourse with Ashok Saini.
legal_principles.held: Whether the respondent proves that after the solemnization of the marriage the appellant had voluntary sexual intercourse with Ashok Saini?

legal_principles.principle: The Family Court's finding that the marital life of the parties was 'like any other ordinary marital life having its own wear and tear' is a relevant consideration.
legal_principles.held: It has been held that only after the original respondent no.2 entered into their marital life 'scene changed'.

outcome.final_order: The appeal is allowed. The decree of dissolution of marriage is set aside.
